description: This file contains a utility class 'ReadingGoalCalculator' that provides static methods for calculating various metrics related to a user's reading goals, such as progress, schedule adherence, and books read within the year. It includes methods for determining if the user is ahead or behind schedule, and interacts with other classes like Book and PredefinedShelf to gather necessary data.

classes.name: ReadingGoalCalculator
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to compute reading progress, schedule adherence, and related metrics for a reading goal.

methods.name: shouldHaveRead
methods.description: Calculates the number of books that should have been read by this point in the year to stay on target.

methods.name: booksToReadFromStartOfYear
methods.description: Determines the weekly reading goal based on total books to read in the year.

methods.name: howManyReadThisYear
methods.description: Counts the number of books or pages read within the current year from a predefined shelf.

methods.name: bookHasFinishDateInThisYear
methods.description: Checks if a given book has a finish date within the current year; used internally for calculations.

methods.name: howFarAheadOrBehindSchedule
methods.description: Calculates the absolute difference between the expected books read by now and the actual books read.

methods.name: calculateProgressTowardsReadingGoal
methods.description: Returns a fraction indicating progress toward the reading goal, capped at 100%.

methods.name: behindOrAheadSchedule
methods.description: Returns a string indicating whether the user is ahead of or behind schedule based on books read versus the target.
